title: Creating Cycle Count Threshold Records
titles: Creating a Cycle Count Threshold Record
breadcrumbs: Creating a Cycle Count Threshold Record

children:
** Use with non-plan 
 based [activity-driven] 
 cycle counting **

These records determine when the system should trigger the creation 
 of a non-plan based [activity-driven] cycle count request for a particular 
 location. When the system checks to see if a location meets a threshold, 
 it will first look to see if a location matches three variables (Location Type,         Work 
 Zone, and         Movement Class). 
 If it the location does not meet all these variables, the system searches 
 for only         Location Type and         Movement Class. If no location meets 
 that criteria, the system searches for         Location 
 Type only. If no locations meet this, the system looks for an all-blank 
 threshold. Also, the user can control the "days between cycle counts" 
 and indicate a threshold quantity (including unit of measure). This quantity 
 determines the minimum item quantity a location has to have in order for 
 the system to trigger a cycle count. By adding a record that has a blank UM and a quantity of '0', you can 
 implement a "verify empty" algorithm. If you wanted to verify 
 empty across the whole warehouse, you could create one record with blank 
 criteria and the appropriate UMs.

If the short pick inventory action (on the Inventory Control Values Window) is set to a "count" option, the system will always to generate a cycle count when a location's quantity is short picked. The system will not take into consideration the cycle count threshold value in this scenario.

Use the Location Type Field to 
 indicate the type of location you want the system to filter by when choosing 
 locations eligible for cycle counting.

Use the Work Zone Field 
 to indicate the type of zone you want the system to filter by when choosing 
 locations eligible for cycle counting.

Use the Movement 
 Class Field to indicate the movement class you want the system 
 to filter by when choosing locations eligible for cycle counting.

Use the Threshold Quantity Field 
 to indicate that you want to count locations whenever they fall below 
 a certain quantity. This value is compared to the location's on hand quantity 
 to see if the location needs to be cycle counted. For example, you would 
 set this value to "0," if you wanted to have a cycle count performed 
 whenever a location is empty.

NOTE: When you set up one 
 quantity and UM combination, the UM does not have to be the base UM. For 
 example, you could specify that a cycle count request should be generated 
 anytime you hit a location in the "Bulk" work zone with a transaction 
 that drops the quantity to 30 Cases or less, and the location has not 
 been counted in the last 60 days.

Use the Days 
 Between Cycle Counts Field to indicate when the next time a cycle 
 count should be performed on this location. The last cycle count date 
 is stamped on the location, and a new request should not be created until 
 the value in this field has exceeded that date.

When finished, 
 press OK. The system will save your record.
